lines.trans: Samsonov family, big greetings to everyone!
I took costumes from the children's theater.
The day after tomorrow you will sing a song at the festival.
Television will show a story about your united family.
Wait, what is happening here?
Nina and I decided to get divorced.
Arkady, close the door, we need to talk.
Have you completely gone out of your mind?
We have a very difficult situation right now.
This performance is our only chance!
You have lived together for twenty years.
Arkady, please don't pressure us.
This is our personal family matter!
I am leaving, and you speak calmly.
And definitely try on these costumes!

examples.trans: I grew up in a communal flat.

meanings.note: 'взять на работу' = to give someone a job
polite to one person, or to several people

meanings.en: other forms: вас (gen/acc), вам (dat), вами (instr), вас (prep)

meanings.note: after 2, 3, 4: года; after 5 and more: лет

examples.trans: I've been working here for four years.

examples.text: Это было давно, тридцать лет назад.
examples.trans: That was long ago, thirty years back.

давить.gloss: to press, to put pressure on

meanings.note: + на + accusative: давить на совесть = to guilt-trip

examples.text: Не надо мне сейчас на совесть давить.
examples.trans: Don't try to make me feel guilty now.

meanings.note: followed by genitive plural in nominative/accusative

examples.trans: The door is behind the wardrobe.

meanings.note: много дел = a lot to do

examples.trans: I have a lot to do.

meanings.note: belonging to children or from childhood

examples.trans: This is an old children's book.
I live in a communal flat.

meanings.note: a door, a shop, or a legal case

examples.trans: I was born and grew up here.
This is my wedding suit, actually!

meanings.en: other forms: нас (gen/acc), нам (dat), нами (instr), нас (prep)

examples.trans: The programme is on the website.
He is running for a second term.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates

meanings.en: it is necessary, one needs to
meanings.note: + dative of the person + infinitive: мне нужно позвонить

examples.trans: I need to make a call.
I'll definitely buy you a tank.

This is my favourite old song.

meanings.en: to have a talk, to speak (with someone)

examples.trans: Shall we show this to Anikeev?

The day after tomorrow is the festival.

meanings.note: takes the accusative; everyday synonym of о

examples.trans: He says nasty things about me.

meanings.en: to happen, take place, go on
meanings.note: Что происходит? = What is going on?

examples.trans: What is going on? I don't understand.

meanings.en: to get divorced, dissolve a marriage
meanings.note: с + instrumental: развестись с мужем = to divorce one's husband

examples.text: Они решили развестись после десяти лет брака.
examples.trans: They decided to divorce after ten years of marriage.

meanings.note: + instrumental; со before some consonant clusters: со всеми

examples.text: Я совсем не это хочу сказать.
examples.trans: That's not what I mean at all.

сойти.gloss: to get off; (с ума) to go mad

meanings.en: to get off, to step down
сойти с ума = to go mad, to lose one's mind

examples.trans: What, have I lost my mind?

examples.text: Тебя даже в простой театр никто не возьмёт!
examples.trans: Nobody will even take you into a simple theatre!

examples.trans: In the evening we went to the city theatre.
